repositories.name: code-flow-studio
repositories.requirements: Documented desktop OS/CPU; actual code execution additionally requires the separately built restricted Docker worker. No host fallback.
limitations: Twelve bounded flat CLI adapters do not cover every framework, dependency or architecture; coverage and unused-code candidates are not correctness or dead-code proof.
Execution needs a separately built local Docker worker with no host fallback. Shared worker identity and containers are not a certified public hostile-code sandbox.
Hashes bind retained bytes and locations, not trusted attestation by a malicious target. UI-only report fixtures are separate from native collector evidence.
Local accounts trust the OS and unlocked service. Downloads are unsigned development builds; no native mobile installer or clean-machine installer lifecycle certification is claimed.

repositories.name: business-knowledge-workbench
repositories.requirements: Use the documented desktop OS and CPU package. Browser-based portable apps print a local URL; extract the complete folder before launch.
limitations: Local owner-account edition; no shared hosted-business identity, invitations or managed tenant deployment is supplied.
Numeric range search covers standardized cells, not OCR or arbitrary source-blob search; unit conversion uses canonical six-place precision.
Export ZIPs are plaintext integrity records, not encrypted or digitally signed; they omit originals and account secrets.
Import and conversion support is adapter-specific; no universal file-format, image/equation understanding or AI-provider compatibility is promised.

repositories.name: personal-image-model-studio
repositories.requirements: Use the documented desktop OS and CPU package. Browser-based portable apps print a local URL; extract the complete folder before launch.
limitations: Integrity and similarity inspect at most 64 eligible images, 32 MiB encoded bytes and 16,777,216 decoded pixels; only 32 candidate pairs are shown, with omissions explicit.
Grayscale hash matches are candidates, not proof of leakage, semantic quality or AI origin. Rights and provenance labels are operator declarations, not legal verification.

The compact native model is not a general photorealistic generator. CPU downloads support native models only; compatible Stable Diffusion/LoRA imports need the explicitly configured full source/runtime.
One unlocked local engine trusts the OS and active service. CPU downloads are unsigned portable applications, not a public hosted service or native mobile installation.

repositories.name: secure-delivery-pipeline-lab
repositories.requirements: Python 3.12+ and official GitHub CLI; authenticate the full four-member bundle before execution. Trusted manager source is installed separately.
limitations: The dependency-free inventory probe is a bounded Python zip application; the reviewed verification and promotion manager is separate source, not a desktop installer or production deployment service.
Impact hashes establish changed bytes, not compatibility or a complete security review. Local receipt aliases are operator assertions, not authenticated human identity or signed audit records.
Verification requires the official GitHub CLI, independently selected source/version and actual attestation checks; checksum or preflight success alone is insufficient.
The synthetic release exercise does not establish production readiness, operational availability or operating-system code signing.
